site.name: Clicks by G
site.tagline: Birds, wildlife and the places they live.
site.home_title: Bird & Wildlife Photography from around the world
site.description: Fine-art bird and wildlife photographs from around the world: hoopoes, kites, egrets and waders. Prints and image licensing by Clicks by G, New Zealand.
about: I'm G. I photograph birds and wildlife, wide landscapes, and cities after dark: patient work that is mostly waiting for the light, or for an animal to look up.
Locations of nesting birds and sensitive species are kept vague on purpose. The welfare of the subject always comes before the shot.
Every photograph here is available as a fine-art print or for licensing. If you'd like one on your wall, or in your project, get in touch.

photos.title: Hoopoe in the canopy
photos.alt: A Eurasian hoopoe with an orange crest and black-and-white barred wings perched on a branch, seen from behind as it looks right, against soft green foliage
photos.caption: Sheltering from the midday glare in the shade of a tree, crest folded.

photos.title: Brahminy kite, face on
photos.alt: A Brahminy kite with a white head and chest and chestnut wings standing on cut rice stubble, looking straight at the camera
photos.caption: On the ground among the rice stubble in the midday sun, watching me as closely as I was watching it.

photos.title: Little egret, still water
photos.alt: A white little egret with long breeding plumes standing in calm water, its reflection stretching below it
photos.caption: Not a ripple on the water. Note the long plumes trailing from the back of its head.

photos.title: Brahminy kite, ruffled
photos.alt: A Brahminy kite with feathers ruffled and beak open, standing in dry rice stubble
photos.caption: Feathers puffed up, mid-call.

photos.title: Marsh sandpiper, morning shallows
photos.alt: A slender grey-and-white marsh sandpiper probing the shallows with a needle-thin bill, mirrored in green water
photos.caption: Feeding along the edge of the shallows at seven in the morning, before the heat.
